# Mathematics Canon for Analysis & Execution

Levels: 1 = accessible · 2 = undergraduate · 3 = graduate/research.


## Track D — Microstructure & Optimal Execution

| Level | Title | Author | Year | Key idea | Concepts |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | **Kissell Optimal Trading** | Robert Kissell & Morton Glantz | 2003 | Transaction-cost analysis and quantitative execution strategies. | `concept_optimal_execution_market_impact` |
| 2 | **Algorithmic Trading and DMA** | Barry Johnson | 2010 | Execution algorithms (VWAP, TWAP, IS, POV) and order-routing mechanics. | `concept_optimal_execution_market_impact`, `concept_vwap`, `concept_trade_execution` |
| 3 | **Continuous Auctions and Insider Trading (paper, Econometrica)** | Albert S. Kyle | 1985 | Informed trading, noise traders, and price impact lambda. | `concept_market_microstructure`, `concept_optimal_execution_market_impact` |
| 3 | **Ohara Microstructure Theory** | Maureen O'Hara | 1995 | Inventory and information models (Kyle, Glosten–Milgrom) of price formation. | `concept_market_microstructure`, `concept_liquidity` |
| 3 | **Optimal Execution of Portfolio Transactions (paper, Journal of Risk)** | Robert Almgren & Neil Chriss | 2000 | Mean-variance optimal liquidation trajectory under temporary/permanent impact. | `concept_optimal_execution_market_impact` |
| 3 | **Hasbrouck Empirical Microstructure** | Joel Hasbrouck | 2007 | Econometrics of trades and quotes: Roll model, price discovery, information shares. | `concept_market_microstructure`, `concept_order_flow` |
| 3 | **Cartea Algorithmic Hft** | Álvaro Cartea, Sebastian Jaimungal & José Penalva | 2015 | Stochastic control for optimal execution, market making, and statistical arbitrage. | `concept_optimal_execution_market_impact`, `concept_market_microstructure` |
| 3 | **The Financial Mathematics of Market Liquidity** | Olivier Guéant | 2016 | From Almgren–Chriss optimal execution to market making, block pricing, and buybacks. | `concept_optimal_execution_market_impact`, `concept_liquidity` |
| 3 | **Bouchaud Trades Quotes Prices** | Jean-Philippe Bouchaud, Julius Bonart, Jonathan Donier & Martin Gould | 2018 | Financial markets under the microscope: order-book dynamics and the square-root impact law. | `concept_optimal_execution_market_impact`, `concept_market_microstructure`, `concept_order_flow` |

## Track A — Probability & Statistics

| Level | Title | Author | Year | Key idea | Concepts |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Fifty Challenging Problems in Probability with Solutions** | Frederick Mosteller | 1965 | Classic puzzles that build probabilistic intuition (gambler's ruin, waiting times). | `concept_risk_of_ruin_drawdown`, `concept_probabilistic_thinking` |
| 1 | **Blitzstein Intro Probability** | Joseph K. Blitzstein & Jessica Hwang | 2014 | Intuition-first probability (Harvard Stat 110 companion): conditioning, expectation, distributions. | `concept_probability_fat_tails`, `concept_expectancy` |
| 2 | **Heard On The Street** | Timothy Falcon Crack | 1995 | Quantitative interview questions in probability and finance. | `concept_probabilistic_thinking` |
| 2 | **All Of Statistics** | Larry Wasserman | 2004 | Concise modern statistics: inference, bootstrap, hypothesis testing, multiple testing. | `concept_overfitting_validation`, `concept_backtesting` |
| 2 | **Quant Interviews Zhou** | Xinfeng Zhou | 2008 | Brain teasers, probability, stochastic calculus, and finance problems with solutions. | `concept_probabilistic_thinking`, `concept_stochastic_processes` |
| 3 | **Feller Probability** | William Feller | 1950 | The classic treatment of random walks, ruin problems, and limit theorems. | `concept_random_walk_efficient_markets`, `concept_risk_of_ruin_drawdown` |
| 3 | **Casella Berger** | George Casella & Roger L. Berger | 1990 | Rigorous estimation and hypothesis-testing theory. | `concept_overfitting_validation` |
| 3 | **Jaynes Probability Logic** | E. T. Jaynes | 2003 | Probability as extended logic; Bayesian inference and maximum entropy. | `concept_probabilistic_thinking`, `concept_edge` |
| 3 | **Statistical Consequences Fat Tails** | Nassim Nicholas Taleb | 2020 | Why sample statistics, the LLN, and standard risk metrics fail under fat tails. | `concept_probability_fat_tails`, `concept_performance_metrics` |
